name: admin_quota_mapping
description: Manages a DuploCloud AI Helpdesk quota mapping — binds a quota definition to a scope (platform-wide or specific workspaces) and a dimension (workspace, user, or ticket).

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the quota mapping. Immutable — changing it forces replacement.

attributes.name: quota_reference_id
attributes.description: ID of the quota definition this mapping binds. Must reference an existing quota definition.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Scope the quota applies at: 'Platform' (organisation-wide) or 'Workspace' (specific workspaces). Defaults to 'Platform'.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Dimension the quota targets. Valid scope/type combinations: Workspace scope with Workspace/User/Ticket; Platform scope with All/Workspace/User. Defaults to 'Workspace'.

attributes.name: target_ids
attributes.description: Workspace IDs this mapping applies to. Required (non-empty) for 'Workspace' scope; must be omitted for 'Platform' scope.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the quota mapping.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Whether the quota mapping is active. Defaults to active when omitted.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who created the quota mapping.

attributes.name: updated_by
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who last updated the quota mapping.

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when the quota mapping was created (RFC 3339).

attributes.name: updated_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when the quota mapping was last updated (RFC 3339).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version counter, incremented on each update.
